subtitle: How Looms Followed Power and Wove a Confederacy Together

panels.shot: epic three-quarter view, low-angle, showing a weaver at a grand loom amid rolls of shimmering silks, with faint silhouettes of Maratha forts and the Narmada in the distance
panels.action: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) sits poised at a large wooden loom, one hand on the shuttle, surrounded by folded saris with peacock motifs and reversible borders, as hazy outlines of Paithan, Yeola and Maheshwar rise behind like a map.

dialogue.text: From ancient Baithana to Maheshwar by the Narmada, weavers of Paithani and Maheshwari turned gold thread into livelihoods under the wide shadow of the Maratha age.

i18n.hi: प्राचीन बैठन से नर्मदा किनारे महेश्वर तक, पैठणी और महेश्वरी बुनकरों ने मराठा दौर की छाँव में सोने के धागे से रोज़ी बनाई।

panels.shot: wide bird's-eye over an old Deccan town with riverfront ghats and market lanes
panels.action: A panoramic view of early Paithan on the Godavari shows stone ghats, clustered houses, and boats moored at a bustling riverbank market, with vendors handling bales of cloth and gleaming threads.

dialogue.text: Long before the Marathas, Paithan on the Godavari drew traders. Ptolemy’s Baithana marked it on distant maps, where cloth and river met the wider world.

i18n.hi: मराठों से बहुत पहले, गोदावरी किनारे पैठण ने सौदागरों को खींचा। टॉलेमी का बैठन दूर के नक्शों पर चमका, जहाँ नदी–कपड़ा दुनिया से मिलते थे।

panels.shot: medium shot, archaeological dig cross-section beside a dry trench
panels.action: Archaeologists in modern attire kneel in a trench near Nevasa, carefully lifting fragile scraps of ancient fabric with tools, while a labelled layer of soil hints at ages beneath Paithan’s horizon.

dialogue.text: Centuries later, at Nevasa near Paithan, buried fragments of silk whispered of older Deccan looms, whose threads once brushed the dust of Satavahana streets.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद, पैठण के पास नेवासा में मिले रेशम के टुकड़े पुराने दक्कनी करघों की फुसफुसाहट थे, जिनके सूत कभी सातवाहन गलियों की धूल छू गए थे।

panels.shot: intimate over-the-shoulder view of hands at a loom
panels.action: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) sits in a dim Paithan workshop, lamplight on their concentrated face, deft fingers inserting colored weft by hand to form a peacock motif on a zari-bordered sari.

dialogue.text: By the seventeenth century, Paithan’s looms sang again, weaving peacocks in tapestry weft and zari borders that caught torchlight in Deccan courts.

i18n.hi: सत्रहवीं सदी तक आते–आते पैठण के करघे फिर गाने लगे—ताने में मोर, किनारों पर ज़री, जो दक्कन दरबारों में मशालों की रोशनी पकड़ लेते।

panels.shot: wide interior shot of a Maratha-era karkhana with multiple looms
panels.action: Inside a large karkhana, rows of Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) figures work at looms, some beating weft, others twisting golden zari, while a steward in Maratha dress inspects the shimmering fabrics stacked neatly.

dialogue.text: Under Deccan sultans and then Maratha chiefs, karkhanas grew. Patronage did not only seek silk; it demanded discipline, pattern books and dependable hands.

i18n.hi: दक्कन सुल्तानों से लेकर मराठा सरदारों तक, कारखाने फले–फूले। सरपरस्ती सिर्फ रेशम नहीं, नियम, नक़्शे और भरोसेमंद हाथ भी माँगती थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of a discussion in a courtyard, with distant fort on a hill
panels.action: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) speaks with a Maratha official in a courtyard, sample saris spread between them, while on a distant hill a fort and town show the shift of political centers inland.

dialogue.text: As Maratha power shifted across the Deccan, so did centers of demand. Weavers weighed news from forts, markets and caravan routes, reading politics like patterns.

i18n.hi: जैसे–जैसे मराठा ताकत दक्कन में घूमी, माँग के ठिकाने भी बदले। बुनकर किलों, बाज़ारों, काफ़िलों की ख़बर तौलते, सियासत को डिज़ाइन की तरह पढ़ते।

panels.shot: wide shot of a street in Yeola with new workshops opening
panels.action: A lively street in Yeola shows new brick houses with open-front workshops where Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) figures set up looms, while bullock carts unload yarn and zari under the watch of local headmen.

dialogue.text: In time, Yeola rose as a weaving town. Families from Paithan and nearby villages set up looms along its lanes, following trade, safety and tax terms, not any one decree.

i18n.hi: वक़्त के साथ, येवला बुनाई का कस्बा बना। पैठण और आस–पास के गाँवों से घराने आए, गलियों में करघे खड़े किए—रोज़गार, अमन और लगान के पीछे, किसी एक हुक्म के नहीं।

panels.shot: close-up of a warp and weft meeting on the loom
panels.action: An extreme close-up shows Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) guiding a colored weft thread across a golden warp, tiny peacock feathers forming, while the metallic zari glows softly in ambient light.

dialogue.text: Paithani’s greatness lay in the loom itself—hand-inserted motifs, solid zari borders, and a body that could carry myth and status on a single shoulder.

i18n.hi: पैठणी की शान खुद करघा था—हाथ से डाले बूटे, ठोस ज़री किनारे, और ऐसा बदन जो एक ही आँचल पर कथा और रुतबा उठा ले।

panels.shot: medium shot of a bustling bazaar where traders examine Paithani
panels.action: In a crowded market, Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) presents folded Paithani saris to a merchant from a coastal city, who tests the weight and drape, while other buyers haggle in the background.

dialogue.text: From Paithan and Yeola, these saris moved to Aurangabad, Burhanpur and beyond. Cloth became coin, and weavers learned to balance court orders with bazaar whims.

i18n.hi: पैठण और येवला से ये साड़ियाँ औरंगाबाद, बुरहानपुर से आगे तक गईं। कपड़ा सिक्का बना, और बुनकरों ने दरबार की फरमाइश और बाज़ार की मर्ज़ियों में संतुलन सीखा।

panels.shot: wide shot of the Narmada at Maheshwar with fort and ghats
panels.action: A majestic view of Maheshwar shows the Narmada flowing past terraced ghats and a riverside fort, while small weaving quarters cluster behind, smoke rising from chimneys in the early morning light.

dialogue.text: Far to the north, at Maheshwar on the Narmada, another story of thread began, under rulers who saw in cloth a way to steady towns and treasuries.

i18n.hi: काफ़ी उत्तर में नर्मदा किनारे महेश्वर में धागे की एक और दास्तान शुरू हुई, उन शासकों के तहत जो कपड़े में शहर और ख़ज़ाने सँभालने का रास्ता देखते थे।

panels.shot: medium shot of weavers from Surat and Mandu arriving in Maheshwar
panels.action: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era), depicted as a group bearing bundles of yarn and tools, arrives at Maheshwar’s gates, being welcomed by local officials with gestures toward prepared workshop houses.

dialogue.text: Weavers from Surat and Mandu were invited to Maheshwar. They brought with them skills honed in older markets, and adapted them to new patrons and river light.

i18n.hi: सूरत और मांडू के बुनकरों को महेश्वर बुलाया गया। वे पुरानी मंडियों के निखरे हुनर लाए, और उन्हें नए सरपरस्तों और नदी की रोशनी के हिसाब से ढाला।

panels.shot: close-up on a Maheshwari sari border showing reversibility
panels.action: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) carefully lifts a finished Maheshwari sari, revealing a crisp, reversible border whose stripes and checks look identical on both sides, framed by a simple body.

dialogue.text: In Maheshwar’s looms, innovation lay in restraint. Light bodies, woven checks, and borders that read the same on both sides made the sari practical yet distinct.

i18n.hi: महेश्वर के करघों की नयापन संयम में था—हल्की देह, बुने चौखाने, और ऐसे किनारे जो दोनों तरफ़ एक जैसे दिखें, साड़ी को कामचलाऊ और अलग दोनों बनाते।

panels.shot: medium shot of a loom set up with cotton and silk mix
panels.action: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) tends a Maheshwari loom where cotton warp and silk weft cross, the shuttle mid-air, as another weaver in the background winds thread on a simple wooden charkha.

dialogue.text: Maheshwari cloth played with cotton and silk, checks and stripes. It suited river towns and inner courts, bridging everyday wear and ceremonial grace.

i18n.hi: महेश्वरी कपड़े ने सूती–रेशमी, चौखाने–पट्टों से खेल किया। वह नदी किनारे कस्बों और अंदरूनी दीवारों दोनों पर जँचा, रोज़मर्रा और रस्मीपन के बीच पुल बना।

panels.shot: two-panel style split: Paithani on left, Maheshwari on right, both mid-weave
panels.action: On the left, Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) in Paithan works on a richly patterned Paithani; on the right, another weaver in Maheshwar works on a simple checked Maheshwari, both focused, their looms mirroring each other.

dialogue.text: Paithani and Maheshwari were not rivals, but answers to different questions—of prestige, of climate, of price—and both served the same expanding Maratha world.

i18n.hi: पैठणी और महेश्वरी दुश्मन नहीं, अलग सवालों के जवाब थे—शान, मौसम, दाम—और दोनों ने उसी फैलते मराठा संसार की सेवा की।

panels.shot: wide shot of a Maratha town street where different professions work
panels.action: A busy Maratha-era street shows Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) at their looms alongside metalworkers, accountants and grain sellers, while a tax clerk notes goods passing a checkpoint.

dialogue.text: These weavers were part of a larger weave—revenue farmers, grain dealers, soldiers, scribes. Gold thread and cotton warp fed into the same tax ledgers and treasuries.

i18n.hi: ये बुनकर भी बड़ी बुनाई का हिस्सा थे—महसूलदार, अनाज कारोबारी, सिपाही, मुंशी। सोने का धागा और सूती ताना एक ही लगान और ख़ज़ाने में दर्ज होते थे।

panels.shot: close-up on a weaver’s thoughtful face at dusk in the workshop
panels.action: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) sits at dusk, resting on the loom beam, face lined with fatigue and pride, as finished saris hang in the shadows behind like quiet flags.

dialogue.speaker: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era)
dialogue.text: A good border feeds a family as surely as a good harvest.

i18n.hi: अच्छी किनारी वैसे ही पेट भरती है जैसे अच्छी फसल।

panels.shot: modern archival-style shot of GI documents and folded saris
panels.action: A modern table displays neatly folded Paithani and Maheshwari saris side by side, while behind them a file of Geographical Indication documents lies open, embossed seals visible under soft light.

dialogue.text: In our own century, Geographical Indication records named these crafts again, preserving community histories, techniques and rights hard-won across turbulent years.

i18n.hi: हमारी सदी में भौगोलिक संकेत के काग़ज़ों ने इन हुनरों को फिर नाम दिया, उन बिरादरी इतिहासों, तरीकों और हकों को बाँधकर जो उथल–पुथल में मुश्किल से बचाए गए थे।

panels.shot: epic low-angle shot of the weaver silhouetted against a backdrop of maps and textiles
panels.action: Paithani & Maheshwari Weaver (Maratha Era) stands holding a Paithani in one hand and a Maheshwari in the other, behind them a translucent map of Paithan, Yeola, Surat and Maheshwar overlaid with faint loom patterns.

dialogue.text: Their legacy is more than ornament. By following power, adjusting patterns and guarding skill, Paithani and Maheshwari weavers showed how humble looms can quietly stitch together economies.

i18n.hi: उनकी विरासत सिर्फ सजावट नहीं। ताकत के पीछे चलते, डिज़ाइन बदलते और हुनर की रखवाली करते पैठणी और महेश्वरी बुनकरों ने दिखाया कि मामूली करघे भी चुपचाप अर्थव्यवस्था जोड़ सकते हैं।

title_i18n.en: Gold Thread in Paithan and Yeola
title_i18n.hi: पैठण और येवला का सुनहरा धागा

subtitle_i18n.en: How Looms Followed Power and Wove a Confederacy Together
subtitle_i18n.hi: करघों ने ताकत के पीछे दौड़कर कैसे एक संघ बुना
